title: ESHA Standards Acceptance List
rules_for_use: Every limit, formula and classification used in an ESHA report must come from the project's active profile in this list.
A project uses ETPL-DEFAULT unless a client profile exists. A client profile overrides only the criteria it lists; all others fall back to ETPL-DEFAULT.

basis = 'standard' means the value is stated in the cited clause. basis = 'etpl_acceptance' means ETPL's adopted criterion; the report prints it as an ETPL acceptance criterion with the reference shown. basis = 'client_spec' means taken from the client's specification document.
The report's Basis of Assessment table is generated from the resolved profile, so the printed source always matches the value used.
Changes to this list are controlled: revision, date and approver recorded.

ETPL-DEFAULT.description: Default for Indian industrial and utility sites

criteria.rule: Corrosivity: <25 severely; 25-50 moderately; 50-100 mildly; >100 very mildly corrosive. No pass/fail.
R = (100*rho / (2*pi*l)) * ln(2*l/d), l and d in cm
R = (rho/4) * sqrt(pi/A), A = area of both sides in m2
R = (100*rho / (2*pi*l)) * ln(4*l/d), d = strip width or 2x conductor diameter, cm
Fall of potential, potential probe at 61.8%; clamp-on, slope or 90/180 as alternatives

params.agreement_tolerance_source: ETPL practice. IS 3043:2018 Cl. 41.1.6 requires the 50% / 70% readings to agree with the 61.8% reading but gives no number; 5% is ETPL's adopted tolerance.

criteria.rule: Healthy <= 0.9 x limit; Warning > 0.9 x limit and <= limit; >Permissible Limit > limit
P1: > limit, not measurable, or C1/C2/C4/C5. P2: warning band or C3/C6/C7/C8. P3: healthy, no code.
Equipment 250-650 V and HV neutrals earthed by two separate and distinct connections (optional check C3)
Zs <= limit for all three phases
criteria.source: ETPL practice; actual device limit per IS/IEC 60364-4-41

criteria.rule: Device breaking capacity (kA) > the higher of PFC (L-PE) and PSC (L-N); Not Assessable if kA not recorded

criteria.source: ETPL practice. IEEE 81-2012 Cl. 10 sets no numeric limit (results are compared riser-to-riser; reference 1.5 V per 15 m for the high-current test, Cl. 10.2); test-lead resistance must be subtracted

criteria.rule: <= calculated electrode limit of the associated pit, or client value

Measured voltage scaled by If/It before comparison (IEEE 81-2012 Cl. 9.3 g). Tolerable: E_step = (1000 + 6*Cs*rho_s)*k/sqrt(ts); E_touch = (1000 + 1.5*Cs*rho_s)*k/sqrt(ts); k = 0.116 (50 kg), 0.157 (70 kg). Client design-calculation limits override.

params.cs_formula: Cs = 1 - 0.09*(1 - rho/rho_s)/(2*h_s + 0.09); Cs = 1 when there is no surface layer
params.cs_formula_reference: IEEE 80-2013, surface layer derating factor Cs

criteria.rule: Healthy <= Zsat; Marginal <= 1.2 x Zsat; else Not Acceptable
criteria.source: ETPL practice; Zsat to be taken from utility/client specification

criteria.rule: 0 unhealthy: Healthy; pass >= 90%: Healthy - Minor Actions; else >Attention Required
Annual; never less than once in two years; records kept
Current injected from remote electrode (>= 5 x largest grid dimension); step probes 1 m apart; touch within 1 m of structure; probes ~150 mm deep; test current recorded per reading

CLIENT-TEMPLATE.description: Copy for a client whose specification sets its own limits. List only the criteria that differ.

revision_history.note: Machine-readable factors and bands added (PIT-BAND, TOWER-ZSAT, OVERALL, SOIL-CLASS); no value changed

Added PIT-METHOD.params.agreement_tolerance_pct (5, etpl_acceptance; used for MS-02 and MS-07) and ST-LIMIT.params.cs_formula / cs_formula_reference / cs_override_field. Draft: date and approver to be recorded on approval.
